Bihar Weather Update: bihar men thand aur kohre ka asar dhire-dhire barhne laga hai. mausam vigyan kendr patna ne 27 navanbar ke mausam ko lekar naya purvanuman jari kiya hai. mausam vibhag ke mutabik, pradesh ke sabhi jilon men mausam shushk rahega aur barish ki koee sanbhavna nahin hai. halanki, subah ke samay adhikansh ilakon men halke se madhyam star ka kohra chha sakta hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
